data.title: 轻井泽惠 · 晨光卫衣下的丰腴私密温存
data.description: 晨光穿透百叶窗洒在凌乱被单上。大号黑色卫衣被推高至纤腰之上，露出光滑诱人的双腿。惠像考拉一样紧紧搂住你的腰身不肯撒手，眼角含着初尝禁果后的迷离泪花，幸福地撒娇赖床。
data.location: warm morning bedroom with rumpled white duvet
data.action: curled up in morning bed with boyfriend hoodie pushed up above waist, clinging tightly to partner waist with bare legs wrapped around him, blissful teary smile
data.lighting: golden morning rays pouring across tangled sheets and smooth bare legs
data.mood: newlywed morning ecstasy, complete surrender, sweet possessive girlfriend joy
